hooks.command: cat > /dev/null; curl -s --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 -X POST "${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.sh}/${NTFY_TOPIC:-claude}" -H 'Title: Claude' -H 'Tags: white_check_mark' -H 'Priority: default' -d 'Done - waiting for your input' > /dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

MSG=$(cat | jq -r 'if .message then .message else "Claude needs attention" end' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Claude needs attention'); [ -z "$MSG" ] && MSG='Claude needs attention'; curl -s --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 -X POST "${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.sh}/${NTFY_TOPIC:-claude}" -H 'Title: Claude' -H 'Tags: bell' -H 'Priority: high' -d "$MSG" > /dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
